entries.title: Ask HN: Is it just me or GPT-4's quality has significantly deteriorated lately?
entries.author: behnamoh
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Is it just me or GPT-4's quality has significantly deteriorated lately?

I say "was" because apparently phind is now trying to use GPT-3.5 and their own Phin
entries.guide_zh: 用户询问 GPT-4 回答是否近期变快却变浅、代码错误也增多。

entries.title: Ask HN: What is new in Algorithms / Data Structures these days?
entries.author: jvanderbot
entries.current_title: Ask HN: What is new in algorithms and data structures these days?
entries.excerpt: Algs/DS were my first love in CS. Nowadays, all we hear about is AI/ML. There must be hardware/software improvements coming from or necessitating fundamental Algs/DS research. Care to share any of the favorite recent results? Are there big fields still making gains behind all this computing surge?
entries.guide_zh: AI 热潮之外，算法与数据结构近年还有哪些值得关注的新进展？

entries.title: Ask HN: How do you not take criticism of your work personally?
entries.author: molly0
entries.current_title: Ask HN: How do you not take criticism of your work personally?
entries.excerpt: I’ve come to realize that I often take constructive criticisms personally. Everything from an unintentionally snarky comment in a PR I’ve made to someone highlight a mistake I’ve made that I probably couldn’t have known about. I see this as one of my major flaws and try hard to mask how I feel. But I just hope to learn to stop feeling bad for honest mistakes.
entries.guide_zh: 工作被提改进意见时总觉得在否定自己，如何把反馈与个人价值分开？

entries.title: We should start to add “ai.txt” as we do for “robots.txt”
entries.author: Jeannen
entries.current_title: Tell HN: We should start to add “ai.txt” as we do for “robots.txt”
entries.excerpt: I started to add an ai.txt to my projects. The file is just a basic text file with some useful info about the website like what it is about, when was it published, the author, etc etc. It can be great if the website somehow ends up in a training dataset (who knows), and it can be super helpful for AI website crawlers, instead of using thousands of tokens to know what your website is about, they can do it with just a few hundred.
entries.guide_zh: 作者提议像 robots.txt 一样为项目添加 ai.txt，并展示写入相关说明的尝试。

entries.title: PSA: Cancelling HP Instant Ink subscription prevents cartridges from being used
entries.author: wfme
entries.current_title: Tell HN: Cancelling HP Instant Ink prevents cartridges from being used
entries.excerpt: I bought an HP printer that came with an HP Instant Ink subscription a year ago. The subscription promises to send you ink when you're running low as long as you print within the designated number of pages. I recently changed my card and figured I would let the subscription expire. Fast forward to today. I go to print something and find that the printer is "unable to print" even though there is ample ink left in the cartridges. I press a button on the printer and it spits out
entries.guide_zh: 发帖者提醒：取消 HP Instant Ink 订阅后，订阅墨盒可能无法继续使用。

entries.title: Ask HN: How do you approach a problem you are not sure has a solution?
entries.author: peteradio
entries.current_title: Ask HN: How do you approach a problem you are not sure has a solution?

I have a very open mind to solving problems but it can make it difficult to come to conclusions. Anyone know what I'm talking about here? Have any advice?
